text:
The diagram shows the effect of a prism on white light.
Some light is reflected on striking the prism and some is refracted and dispersed to form a
spectrum.

light
white

What happens if monochromatic light is used instead of white light?
A
The light changes colour as it passes through the prism.
B
The light forms a brighter spectrum.
C
There is no reflected light.
D
There is no dispersion of the emerging light.

options.label: A
options.text: The light changes colour as it passes through the prism.

options.label: B
options.text: The light forms a brighter spectrum.

options.label: D
options.text: There is no dispersion of the emerging light.
